changelog: 1.2.5: Owner-approved beta.5 playback code promoted unchanged
English StreamUnity routing with available server alternatives
Cinejoy-first subtitles with Wyzie fallback and bounded on-demand caching
Available Arabic and other subtitle languages appear in the normal player list
Reject obvious non-English script mismatches in English subtitle candidates
Background cross-provider 4K enrichment is not included
1.0.2: Owner-approved public promotion of 1.0.1-beta.5, with the supplied Synthetiq Anime artwork; playback JavaScript unchanged.
Fresh provider links, available server alternatives, and provider captions with language labels.
Short probes decoded 30/30 Sub and 29/30 Dub samples. These are not full-device playback or spoken-language certification.
Known issues remain: Spy x Family episode 1 Dub returned Japanese audio; Naruto episode 1 Dub failed one seeked media sample. See the release QA notes.
